concept_attempts.feedback: Accepted with specific modelling corrections: the concept adds a second red upper slit and an overlong tip. Source-visible front fields are distinct from interpreted rear continuation.

Maintained the narrow-neck and crown/base width contracts; an intermediate candidate failing those proportions was rejected before rendering.

glb_feedback.observation: Final actual independent-import quarter/front/rear views and native pairs reviewed after the shape correction. The true through-passage and source-visible fields remain clear.
glb_feedback.action: Accept for integration review subject to final user artistic acceptance and game-client scale/state/FPS. Rear windows and passage continuation are interpretation, not a recovered hidden view.

glb_feedback.observation: Studio renders made the red status fields too pale, and the curved shell required deeper support behind the top window-rim corners.
glb_feedback.action: Darkened the red alloy with authored wear, kept its single source slit, and extended only the hidden rim bodies into the quarters. Sixteen actual rim-corner support checks now run on both source and import; glazing depths and doorway clearance remain enforced.

review: Legacy-led static medical/herbal-treatment facility; broad rounded lower quarters, true arched passage, paired warm lights, narrow blue-inset neck, onion upper chamber with flowing castings and one red slit. Sparse seams and restrained wear, no invented plants or medical symbols. Same canonical rooted geometry for gameplay/build/SciTek; approximate review camera, no numerical fidelity claim.
